summary.text: Chris Meagher is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Wendouree at the 2026 Victorian election. He leads ICT projects at Grampians Health, having earlier worked in IT support for a UK healthcare analytics company, and calls himself a Ballarat local and a unionist. He has volunteered with the NSW SES and Rural Fire Service and now with a CFA brigade.

priorities.text: Force investors with empty properties to either house people or sell.
Urgently cut and freeze rents.
Minimum quality standards for all rentals, strictly enforced
A large public housing building program
Planning for Ballarat's growth, with better public and active transport

sources.title: Wendouree: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Ellen Burns is the Greens candidate for Wendouree at the 2026 Victorian election, her second run for the seat after 2022, when she won 10.4 per cent of the first-preference vote. She describes herself as a local mother, sustainability educator and food security advocate, and is behind two local ventures, Smart Living Ballarat and The Hidden Orchard.

occupation.text: Sustainability educator; runs Smart Living Ballarat and The Hidden Orchard

priorities.text: we deserve leadership that takes the serious issues seriously
Action on climate and on housing
Resilient communities with secure food supplies
Better public transport and relief from the cost of living

sources.title: Wendouree: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Gav (Gavin) Ronan is the Liberal candidate for Wendouree at the 2026 Victorian election. He grew up on his family's farm near Ballarat, worked in IT, accounting and business management, and spent ten years as owner of a Great Ocean Road lodge walk before starting a tourism business in Ballarat. He also runs the family farm.

prior_roles.role: Owner, lodge walk on the Great Ocean Road

priorities.text: Safer communities
A stronger local economy and lower living costs
A fair share of infrastructure spending for regional Victoria

summary.text: Juliana Addison has been Labor's member for Wendouree, in Ballarat, since winning the seat at the 2018 election on Sharon Knight's retirement, and she held it again in 2022. A history teacher before entering Parliament, she has been an acting speaker since 2023 and has chaired the Assembly's environment and planning committee. She is contesting Wendouree again in 2026.

prior_roles.role: Chair, Legislative Assembly Environment and Planning Committee
Chair, Legislative Assembly Environment and Planning Committee

prior_roles.note: Wikipedia says she taught there for 11 years before the 2018 election.

priorities.text: Good schools
High-quality health care
A strong local economy with secure, well-paid jobs
Families being safe at home
Excellent sporting and cultural facilities

summary.text: Melissa Collins is the Animal Justice Party candidate for Wendouree at the 2026 Victorian election. A clinical neuropsychologist who grew up in Sydney, she now lives in regional Victoria, works on habitat restoration with her local Landcare group, and co-founded the Ballarat Good Karma Network. The party says she led a formal community objection to a battery storage project planned for Mount Doran.

priorities.text: Phasing out factory farming and tougher penalties for animal cruelty
Affordable vet care for low-income households and funding for wildlife rescue
Urgent climate action and stronger environmental protections
Responses to family violence, and more affordable housing that accepts pets
Universal healthcare and better access to mental health services

sources.title: Wendouree: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Ruth Byrne is standing for Family First in Wendouree at the 2026 Victorian election. A registered teacher who taught music and Christian studies at Ballarat Christian College, she now works full time as a minister of the Rise Christian Church, Delacombe, and was ordained in 2008. She came to the Ballarat area from Western Australia in 2011, where she and her husband had run a concreting business.

occupation.text: Minister, Rise Christian Church; registered teacher

prior_roles.role: Teacher, Director of Music and Director of Christian Studies
Founder, ministry supporting women and children in the sex industry

priorities.text: Education and support for strong families
Freedom of speech and of religion
Protection of human life
Responsible economic policy as a path out of poverty
